background: LBBW is the Landesbank of Baden-Wurttemberg, owned by the state, the regional savings banks and the city of Stuttgart, a corporate, real-estate and capital-markets lender that also runs retail banking through BW-Bank.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the bank, at AA- on average and both on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of them on 12 May 2026 — a high rating that rests on the ownership rather than the ratios. CET1 of 16.1% is just above the peer median, but leverage of 4.5%, LCR of 136% and NSFR of 113% are all in the bottom quarter of EU and Nordic banks. The trend is mildly negative: CET1 down 0.5 points and NSFR down 8 points since 30 Jun 2025, with leverage and LCR broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026). Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
